７ Note
If you choose to create a 'Global exception' in the Defender Vulnerability management
security recommendation, the status in the Microsoft Secure Score recommended action
will be updated with the exception justification. Updates may take up to 2 hours.
If you choose to create an 'Exception per device group' in the Defender Vulnerability
manage security recommendation, Secure Score will not be updated and the
recommended action will remain as 'To address'.
